content: The body is a transient bubble upon the water; use this brief breath to awaken eternal consciousness.
author: Kabir
explanation: The world you perceive is a reflection of your internal state. When the mind is cloudy with grievance, everything looks hostile; cleanse the mind, and the world reflects grace.
practicalInsight: Clear mental grievances before going to sleep tonight. Forgive and release all grudges.
reflectionPrompt: Is the world really difficult today, or is my internal lens dusty?
